title: Areas & assignments
subtitle: The branch's areas and which staff member looks after the customers in each.
pickBranch: Pick one branch at the top first
uncovered: {{areas}} areas have nobody responsible, with {{customers}} customers in them.
emptyBody: Create an area and assign a staff member.
assignDesc: Customers of this area appear in the staff member's app. An area can have more than one staff member.
removeDesc: The {{n}} customers of {{area}} will no longer show in {{name}}'s app.
lastOne: This is the only staff member of the area. Removing them leaves the area with nobody responsible.

form.desc: An area is a group of one or more ERP area codes.
form.codeHelp: For example BRL01-RUP. Capital letters, digits and hyphens.
form.erpHelp: Separate with commas, for example RUP1, RUP2

errors.code: Use a code of 2 to 20 characters (A-Z, 0-9, hyphen)
errors.erpCodes: Enter at least one ERP area code

bulk.title: Assign {{n}} customers to one staff member
bulk.desc: The selected customers will appear in this staff member's app. Anyone who held them before loses them.
bulk.skipped: {{n}} already belonged to this staff member
bulk.tooMany: At most {{n}} customers can be assigned at once
